description:
Cha-Ching gives indie founders and small software businesses a focused way to know when Stripe verifies a successful payment.

Sign in with Apple, connect Stripe through its provider-hosted authorization page, and receive a payment alert on your iPhone. Verified Stripe sales remain visible in your history without storing customer names, email addresses, or full webhook payloads.

Version 1.0 features:
• Secure Sign in with Apple
• Connect one Stripe account
• Verified Stripe payment alerts
• Real sales history
• Notification and connection controls
• PayPal account linking where available

Provider access tokens are encrypted before storage and are never persisted on your iPhone. PayPal payment alerts are not supported in version 1.0. Cha-Ching is not accounting, banking, payout, reconciliation, tax, or financial-advice software.
promotionalText: Connect Stripe and let Cha-Ching tell you when a verified payment lands.
